explanation: D2 is always high: 10 early in the episode and when the agent chose a2, dropping to about 9 for a1 mid-episode and 6-7 after trial 85. D1 is about 8-9 when the previous trial was rewarded and 4-6 when it wasnt (down to 0-3 after a run of unrewarded trials late in the episode), while GO is mid-range at about 5-6 for a2 early on, about 2-4 for a1 mid-episode, and falls to 0-1 after trial 85 regardless of choice.
